answer: Locks are written down in mirror, expire in cedar, and hollow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 195 aliases therefore needs 42 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3248 identities would post 3495 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
